What INGCO & Skillcraft Bring

The Source of Truth for Product & Store

The quality of the journey depends on trusted product information and a clear route into the real retail network.

Approved product knowledge

Model information, specifications, manuals, the 20V platform range and accessories DadBod may use.

Participating store directory

Concept Stores, Shop-in-Shops and retail partners to surface, with accurate addresses.

Retail activation

Store openings, counter material, social content and contractor days that invite WhatsApp questions.

Campaign & promotion input

Approved campaign details, product priorities and retail offers to shape the journey.

Data feeds where practical

Live or near-live stock and pricing, explored later where reliable data is available.

Retailer feedback loop

Pilot results and retailer feedback to refine products, questions and journeys.

Launch Wide, Measure Clearly, Keep Improving

A Multi-Store Gauteng Rollout

Rather than testing on a single store, the launch runs across a cluster of participating INGCO locations from day one, giving a realistic read on demand across geographies and formats.

  • Onboard a cluster of Concept Stores, Shop-in-Shops and retailers across Gauteng together
  • Load approved INGCO categories, specs and the 20V platform data
  • Map every participating location for tracked WhatsApp journeys
  • Co-branded activation across all launch stores at once
  • Accept homeowner and contractor product questions network-wide
  • Guide users through INGCO options and store options nearest them
  • Run store, social and contractor-day prompts across all sites
  • Review questions, categories and routing performance weekly
  • Measure enquiries, store searches and referral activity by location
  • Compare performance across store formats and regions
  • Add underperforming or high-demand areas into the network
  • Scale toward a national rollout once the model is proven
